items.title: Origin, moved over
items.text: Origin now installs under its own name, so it can sit beside Stremio Origin. Your sign-in and settings came with it, and the old copy was removed.
items.text_android: Origin now installs under its own name, so it can sit beside Stremio Origin. Your sign-in and settings came with it. Android asks once before it removes the old copy.

items.title: A new top bar
items.text: Search, Home, Shows, Movies, Catalogue and My List across the top. Your profile picture opens profiles, Settings and Exit.

items.title: Shows, Movies and Anime
items.text: Each tab opens on a billboard with rows of its own and your Continue Watching first, with no limit on how many it shows. Turn on Anime in Settings > Appearance.
